briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 launch intensifies US-China AGI race as compute shortages bite

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases amid regulatory scrutiny and hardware constraints. US entities maintain lead but Chinese labs close gap rapidly with efficient architectures.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with 2.1T parameters; Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus benchmarks highest on agentic tasks; Google Gemini 3 integrates real-time video reasoning; xAI and DeepSeek push open weights aggressively.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines mandate red-teaming for all frontier deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC ramps 3nm AI chips for NVIDIA; Microsoft and Google announce $45B combined data center expansions; power grid bottlenecks delay 18% of planned clusters.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first AGI system emerge from a US lab or a multinational alliance by 2028?
